name: Shiphrah
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: The king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, Shiphrah and Puah: when ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, if it be a son, then ye shall kill him. Pharaoh commanded the male children killed at birth. That is oppression, and America does the same thing.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt
